projects.title: High Atmospheric Weather Ballon
projects.description:
Our project goals are:
-Collect readings from atmospheric, position, and flight sensors using arduino
-Transmit telemetry and sensor reading over 2-meter using AX.25 protocol
-Capture images of horizon and ground during flight using Raspberry-Pi + cam
-Transmit images over 70-cm using Slow Scan Digital Video protocol
-House all sensors and equipment in multi-use case
-Recover payload in working order

projects.title: Solar Tracker
projects.description:
This project's goal was to get us engineering/project experience. We got funding from the school and have been working on it through the internship and now along with classes.
We want to find and track the sun with 1/2 degree precision using photo resisters when relay the coordinates over radio to a separate, self-powered structure to point a solar panel at the sun also. 

This project has allowed us to gain experience in conceptual brain storming, CAD drawing, structural designing, simple circuitry, programming, radio communication, BlueTooth communication, use of sensors (temperature, pressure, and humidity), and hopefully some image processing after everything is finished.
